- [#13473](https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/13473) Fix incorrect lag due to trimming stream via \`XTRIM\` command
- [#13338](https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/13338) Fix incorrect lag field in \`XINFO\` when tombstone is after the

expiration data structure

handled by it

- [#13422](https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/13422) Cluster: Fix \`CLUSTER SHARDS\` command returns empty array

memory

\`lpFind\`
- [#13505](https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/13505) Optimize \`STRING\` datatype write commands
- [#13499](https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/13499) Optimize \`SMEMBERS\` command
- [#13494](https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/13494) Optimize \`GEO\*\` commands reply
- [#13490](https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/13490) Optimize \`HELLO\` command
- [#13488](https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/13488) Optimize client query buffer
- [#12395](https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/12395) Optimize \`SCAN\` command when matching data type
- [#13529](https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/13529) Optimize \`LREM\`, \`LPOS\`, \`LINSERT\`, and \`LINDEX\` commands
- [#13516](https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/13516) Optimize \`LRANGE\` and other commands that perform several

threads

Changes (mirroring upstream fix PR redis/redis#13338):

- src/networking.c:4738 — in `streamReplyWithRange`, the entries_read validity check now uses `group->last_id` (not the delivered entry id) so tombstones between the group's last-delivered-id and the new entry invalidate/repair the counter correctly.
